advisory.unencrypted_data_channel: The data channel uses no cipher: everything sent through the tunnel can be read and changed on the way. Use this only if the provider gives no other option.
advisory.weak_cipher: The cipher is outdated. Prefer AES-256-GCM or CHACHA20-POLY1305 if the server supports them.
advisory.weak_digest: The authentication digest is weak. Prefer SHA256 or an AEAD cipher.
advisory.compression_enabled: Compression is enabled. It is deprecated and can leak data (VORACLE).
advisory.tls_auth_instead_of_crypt: tls-auth is used; tls-crypt also hides the handshake.
advisory.server_usage_check_disabled: The check that the server certificate is issued for a server is off.
advisory.fragment_in_use: fragment is set: a legacy workaround for MTU problems that slows the tunnel.
advisory.no_dco: This host's kernel has no data channel offload; expect lower throughput.

code.runs_code: runs programs or scripts, which TunnelDeck-VPN does not allow.
code.escapes_sandbox: would change files or the process, which TunnelDeck-VPN does not allow.
code.duplicate_directive: appears more than once; only one is kept.
code.managed_by_field: is set through a profile field.
code.deprecated_ignored: is deprecated and ignored by OpenVPN.
code.invalid_directive: is not a valid OpenVPN directive.
code.inline_block: inline blocks are only allowed for keys and certificates.
code.invalid_value: has a value TunnelDeck-VPN cannot use.
code.file_reference: refers to a file; paste its content into the profile instead.
code.additional_remote: is an additional server; only the first one is used.
code.unsupported_device: sets a device type TunnelDeck-VPN does not support.
code.inline_block_unsupported: is an inline block TunnelDeck-VPN does not support.
code.cipher_mapped: was converted to the current cipher setting.
code.compression_receive_only: compression is accepted from the server but not used for sending.
code.compression_kept: compression stays on because the server requires it.
code.ns_cert_type_mapped: was replaced by the server certificate check.
code.server_cert_usage_added: The server certificate check was switched on.
code.static_key_unsupported: uses static-key mode, which is insecure and deprecated; use certificates or username and password instead.

hint.tun-device: Pass the TUN device into the container (devices: /dev/net/tun).
hint.iptables: Install iptables in the image and make sure the host kernel provides the iptables filter table.
hint.net-admin: Grant the container the NET_ADMIN capability (cap_add: NET_ADMIN).
hint.ip-forward: Enable IPv4 forwarding on the host (sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=1, persisted in /etc/sysctl.conf); Docker hosts normally have it on. Without it, rules to other devices and outbound rules forward nothing.
hint.lan-subnets: Run the container with network_mode: host on a host that has an IPv4 address on its LAN interface.
hint.rule-counters: Load the comment match on the host (modprobe xt_comment), or use the nft backend (TUNNELDECK_IPTABLES=nft), then restart the container. The firewall works without it; only the hit counters are off.

fieldError.time_format: Enter a time as HH:MM (00:00 to 23:59).
fieldError.secret_replace_and_clear: Cannot be replaced and cleared at once.
fieldError.not_string_list: Must be a list of text entries.
fieldError.host_invalid: Enter a host name or an IP address.
fieldError.port_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 65535.
fieldError.file_too_large: The file must be at most {{max}}.
fieldError.ipv4_prefix_invalid: Enter an IPv4 address or a network in CIDR notation without host bits, e.g. {{example}}.
fieldError.port_range_reversed: The range must not end before it starts.
fieldError.port_range_too_long: A range covers at most {{max}} ports.
fieldError.firewall_keep_source_forward_only: Applies only to inbound rules to another device in the local LAN.
fieldError.firewall_forward_accepts_only: Drop and reject work only for this device’s own address; rules to other devices always allow.
fieldError.firewall_action_invalid: Must be Allow, Drop or Reject.
fieldError.firewall_forward_protocol: Rules to other devices forward TCP, UDP, TCP+UDP, ESP or GRE; ICMP and Any work only for this device’s own address.
fieldError.firewall_accept_any_protocol: Allowing every protocol would open every port of the host; choose a protocol.
fieldError.firewall_icmp_type_invalid: Enter an ICMP type name such as echo-request, or a number with an optional /code.
fieldError.firewall_outbound_source_required: Required: the LAN device or subnet whose traffic goes through the tunnel.
fieldError.firewall_outbound_source_everything: Must be a LAN device or subnet, not every address.
fieldError.firewall_inbound_single_address: Enter a single IPv4 address in the local LAN, e.g. {{example}}.
fieldError.firewall_ports_need_tcp_udp: Ports apply only to TCP, UDP and TCP+UDP.
fieldError.firewall_public_port_needs_destination_p: Leave empty while the destination port is empty (any port).
fieldError.firewall_public_port_length: Must cover as many ports as the destination port.
fieldError.firewall_duplicate_id: Another rule uses the same ID.
fieldError.firewall_duplicate_rule: Duplicates rule {{rule}} (same direction, protocol, addresses and ports).
fieldError.firewall_public_address_conflict: Conflicts with rule {{rule}} on the shared public address.
fieldError.firewall_ui_port: Must not include the web UI port.
fieldError.firewall_remote_access_port: Must not include the port of remote access.
fieldError.firewall_lan_not_detected: Must be inside the local LAN, but none was detected.
fieldError.openvpn_cipher_invalid: Enter a cipher name or a colon-separated list of cipher names.
fieldError.openvpn_digest_invalid: Enter a digest name such as SHA256, or none.
fieldError.openvpn_tls_crypt_with_tls_auth: Cannot be combined with a tls-auth key.
fieldError.openvpn_pkcs12_with_client_cert: Cannot be combined with a client certificate and key; use one of the two.
fieldError.openvpn_resolve_retry_invalid: Enter infinite or a number of seconds.
fieldError.openvpn_keepalive_invalid: Enter two positive numbers of seconds, for example 10 60.
fieldError.openvpn_client_key_required: Required unless a PKCS#12 file is given.
fieldError.openvpn_certificate_invalid: Must contain one or more PEM certificates (RFC 7468).
fieldError.openvpn_private_key_invalid: Must contain exactly one PEM private key (RFC 7468).
fieldError.openvpn_static_key_invalid: Must be an OpenVPN static key (2048 bit, V1).
fieldError.openvpn_pkcs12_invalid: Must be a base64-encoded PKCS#12 file (.p12, .pfx) of at most 64 KiB.
fieldError.openvpn_block_not_closed: Line {{line}}: the inline block <{{block}}> is not closed.
fieldError.remote_network_not_cidr: Entry {{entry}}: enter an IPv4 network in CIDR notation, such as 10.1.2.0/24.
fieldError.remote_network_not_canonical: Entry {{entry}}: write the network address with its prefix length, such as 10.1.2.0/24.
fieldError.remote_network_everything: Entry {{entry}} must not cover every address.
fieldError.remote_network_contains_server: Entry {{entry}} contains the server address, which must stay outside the tunnel.
fieldError.remote_network_overlaps_lan: Entry {{entry}} overlaps a LAN subnet of the host ({{subnets}}).
fieldError.firewall_id_invalid: Must be 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
fieldError.remote_access_ui_port: Must not be the port of the web UI.
fieldError.remote_access_port_in_firewall: An enabled firewall rule uses this port.
fieldError.remote_access_certificate_invalid: Must be a PEM certificate chain, the server certificate first.
fieldError.remote_access_certificate_not_yet_valid: The certificate is not valid yet.
fieldError.remote_access_key_not_pem: Must contain exactly one PEM private key.
fieldError.remote_access_key_encrypted: The private key must not be encrypted.
fieldError.remote_access_key_unsupported: Must be an RSA key of at least 2048 bits, an ECDSA P-256 or P-384 key, or an Ed25519 key.
fieldError.remote_access_key_unparseable: The private key cannot be read.
fieldError.remote_access_key_mismatch: The private key does not belong to the certificate.
fieldError.username_invalid: {{min}} to {{max}} characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
fieldError.vpn_address_invalid: The VPN did not assign a valid IPv4 address.
fieldError.firewall_public_port_own_address: A rule to this device’s own address needs no port on the VPN address; leave it empty.
fieldError.firewall_destination_not_in_lan: Must be inside the local LAN ({{subnets}}).
fieldError.firewall_template_own_address: Enter another device in the local LAN, not this device’s own address.
